title: Lead
description: One prospect moving through the pipeline. Every stage reads and writes this. Owner: Ayaan. Change it only by PR with everyone's OK.

customer_id.description: Which customer's brief this lead belongs to

source.description: Where the lead came from. The source is not the record; the Sales DB is (docs/fleet-prompts-v2.md §2)

source_id.description: The lead's ID in the source system, e.g. the Salesforce Lead Id

created_at.description: When add_lead put the lead in the lead sheet (Salesforce: CreatedDate)

updated_at.description: Last time anything was logged for this lead

stage_times.description: When the lead first reached each stage, e.g. {"replied": ..., "handed_off": ...}. Gives reply-to-rep time and cycle time

attempts.description: How many times check_ready_to_write said no. After 2 the lead goes on_hold

variant.description: Which arm of the research-vs-template A/B test this lead got

draft_to.description: Who the draft goes to: the lead, or whoever the conversation moved to

draft_cc.description: Copied in. The approval covers to, cc, subject and body

draft_in_reply_to.description: message_id the draft answers, so it stays in the thread

thread_id.description: One email thread per lead; every message carries it

thread_subject.description: Subject of the first email; later emails use Re: <thread_subject>

scheduled_for.description: Set while an approved email is held until business hours in the lead's country

follow_ups.description: Follow-ups sent since the prospect last wrote. At 2, no more follow-ups

reply_from.description: Who wrote the last reply. Not always the lead (an assistant, a colleague)

next_to.description: Who our next email goes to: the last sender (reply to all), or the colleague the lead handed over to

next_cc.description: Everyone else in the conversation, kept in cc on the next email

handover_to.description: Email of the colleague the lead handed over to

approval.description: Written by record_approval. send_email only sends the draft this approval covers (draft_hash)

contacts.description: Other people in the conversation, added by read_reply. Never our own sender or reps

role.description: cc: copied in by the prospect; replied_for_lead: wrote instead of the lead (an assistant); handover: the lead passed the conversation to them; referral: named by a wrong_person reply

needs_person.description: The lead waits for a person's decision; due_follow_ups lists it until the lead moves on

do_not_contact.description: Set by an unsubscribe reply. send_email refuses the lead from then on

event_id.description: The meeting in the rep's calendar (store.CALENDARS)

follow_up_due.description: When to email the prospect new times after a cancellation or no-show

meeting_outcome.description: Set by the rep after the meeting with record_meeting_outcome. held counts toward the North Star (qualified meetings held)

deal.description: Opened when a meeting is held, or by auto-close. Like a Salesforce Opportunity. The rep runs it; the agent drafts and records. Won or lost lives in the lead's status and loss_reason, not here

auto_close.description: true when the agent closes it alone (small standard deal)

bant.description: From the rep's call notes. unknown never blocks a quote

payment_status.description: Auto-close checkout. partial and refunded wait for a person (needs_person)

payment_retry_due.description: After a failed payment: when the checkout link goes out again

offer_sent_at.description: When the auto-close offer actually went out (after any hold for business hours)

offer_reminders.description: Reminders sent for an unpaid offer; at most 2, and after 7 working days it goes to a rep

refunded.description: Refunded after the win: not counted in won revenue

amount_eur.description: Final value of a won deal (Salesforce: Opportunity.Amount)

status.description: on_hold: research still thin after 2 retries. queued: positive reply waiting for a free rep. Neither is lost
